headline: South Africa's Mr Price Sales Jump 42% Following NKD Europe Deal
summary: South African retailer Mr Price reported a 41.8% sales increase after purchasing European fashion retailer NKD. Headline earnings per share grew 2.0%, while executive leadership forecast a challenging festive retail season.
why: Mr Price Group is a major South African value apparel and homeware retailer listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

impacts.name: Mr Price Group
impacts.why: Retail group posted 42% revenue growth driven by the integration of acquired European retailer NKD.
